articles.title: Nintendo Switch Online Adds Three Classic Game Boy Games Today
articles.summary: Nintendo is enhancing its Switch Online retro library by adding three more classic Game Boy games, starting October 27th. This expansion includes 'Amazing Tater,' 'Quest for Camelot,' and notably, 'Castlevania Legends,' alongside a lesser-known puzzle-adventure title from legendary designer Shigeru Miyamoto, offering subscribers more nostalgic gaming options.

articles.title: Sarvam inks 5-yr pact with Defence Ministry for AI projects across armed forces
articles.summary: Indian AI startup Sarvam has signed a five-year agreement with the Ministry of Defence to develop and deploy advanced AI applications across the armed forces. This strategic partnership aims to enhance operational capabilities, efficiency, and preparedness by integrating cutting-edge artificial intelligence solutions into military operations, modernizing India's defence infrastructure.

articles.title: EXCLUSIVE: Breast Pump Maker Willow Acquires Swehl, Momtech
articles.summary: Breast pump manufacturer Willow Innovations Inc. is significantly expanding its portfolio in 2025 through key acquisitions. Following an initial purchase, the company has now acquired Swehl, an online education platform, and another firm. This strategic move underscores Willow Innovations' aggressive growth and diversification strategy, enhancing its presence in the health technology and education sectors through corporate consolidation.

articles.title: Trump’s Blob
articles.summary: Sebastian Gorka, the White House’s senior director for counterterrorism, addressed the prestigious Council on Foreign Relations in Washington, D.C., in mid-March. His address likely focused on crucial aspects of U.S. counterterrorism policy and its broader implications for international relations, offering vital insights into America's global security posture and strategic engagement with other nations.

articles.title: Fighting paused in Ukrainian city under deal announced by Melania Trump
articles.summary: A ceasefire, reportedly brokered with assistance from Melania Trump, has taken effect in the Russian-occupied Ukrainian city of Oleshky. Both Russian and Ukrainian forces committed to observing the truce, which commenced on Tuesday. This development aims to temporarily halt hostilities in the conflict-ridden region, marking a significant, albeit potentially fragile, diplomatic effort amidst the ongoing war.

articles.title: 'Chinese troops have entered 40-50 km into Indian territory': Arunachal Congress chief Bosiram Siram on border situation
articles.summary: Arunachal Pradesh Congress President Bosiram Siram, a former Education Minister, has alleged that Chinese troops have intruded 40 to 50 kilometres deep into Indian territory. This serious claim highlights ongoing border security challenges along the Line of Actual Control (LAC), directly impacting India's sovereignty and territorial integrity. SSB aspirants should be aware of such geopolitical developments concerning national defence.
